description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'GenericMapValues' that provides a collection view of the values in a Map, including implementations for contains, equals, hashCode, and remove methods.

classes.name: GenericMapValues
classes.description: An abstract class representing a collection of the values contained in a Map, with typical collection operations overridden for map values.
